answer_1.quote: automated radiology report generation has attracted increasing research attention.

answer_2.quote: We adopt natural language generation metrics (NLG Metrics) and clinical efficacy (CE Metrics) to evaluate the models. BLEU, METEOR, and ROUGE are selected as NLG Metrics, and we use the MS-COCO caption evaluation tool to compute the results. For CE Metrics, we adopt CheXpert for MIMIC-CXR dataset to label the generated reports compared with disease labels of the references.
